title: Task Request
description: Request body for submitting a task to a registered capability.

capability_id.description: The capability_id of a previously registered capability.

input.description: Task input, validated against the target capability's input_schema.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint HUBVERY will POST task events to, as CloudEvents envelopes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Submitting the same key twice returns the original task instead of creating a duplicate.
